build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (see that plugin's registration in nx.json for why the inferred `tsc --build tsconfig.lib.json` cannot run in this workspace). The retired executor's `generatePackageJson`/`updateBuildableProjectDepsInPackageJson`/`createLockFile` are covered downstream by the `dist-manifest` + `sync-deps` targets; `*.md` assets are covered by the inferred `assets` target.

test.//: Override of the inferred `test` target (dependsOn only; executor/cache/outputs come from inference). The suite reads this project's OWN built dist/ (including the manifest/package.json emitted by `assets` via `dist-manifest`), which targetDefaults.test's `^build` never provides. `lint`/`^build` repeated because an explicit dependsOn replaces the targetDefault.

typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the SPEC corpus (entrypoint/decompile-cli/tsconfig.spec.json). Closes lane-reachability rule 6 / backlog 770c0919: a tsconfig.spec.json with no compiling target lets the spec corpus carry type errors no gate can see. The ratchet baselines the pre-existing spec errors in tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/decompile-cli.baseline.json (baselined, NOT excluded) and fails on any per-file increase or on include narrowing. Wired into test.dependsOn so nx affected -t test runs it.
